args.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE NEW landscape 1536x1024 transparent PNG character sheet: EXACTLY SIX large unique KFB ink blob monsters, THREE COLUMNS by TWO ROWS. Both input PNGs are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, not edit targets: reference1 for whole rounded dark ink body, rich soft clay modeling and sculpted lids; reference2 for the craft of clay wood/leather/metal props. New subjects, not copied costumes/faces.
Theme: absurd-surreal weird Union/Yankee US Civil War soldier troupe with Northern-Western vibe. Deep navy-blue kepis, Union blue partial uniform panels, brass buttons and leather equipment; two female-read actors. Satirical military temperaments, not real person likenesses. These must be six DIFFERENT CHARACTERS, not recolored Confederates. No flags with stars/stripes, logos, lettering, text or scene.
Family invariants: one continuous COMPLETE upright footless charcoal-black ink splat, subtle deep violet sheen, big face directly in goo, thick soft rounded asymmetric lobes, tiny rounded goo hands, a few controlled detached drops. No human torso/legs/feet, busts, fur, spiky rock shapes. Clothing limited to cuffs, collar, shoulder panels, straps, letting most dark body show. Fingerprinted fine handmade plasticine with rich rounded volumes and selective wear, soft upper-left studio light. Offbeat tactile cartoon, not generic Pixar human mascots.
EVERY visible eye: WHITE/IVORY EYEBALL surrounding small RED IRIS and BLACK PUPIL, thick purple clay eyelids. No glowing red eyeballs. Individual mouth/lip shapes, irregular ivory teeth only where visible, never six repeated grins. No dangling tongues.

TOP LEFT — FEMALE-READ BRIGADE COMMANDER. Tall upright tapering pear with one sideways crown loop, navy officer kepi unusually small on her broad brow, short tucked clay side curl, restrained brass shoulder stars. Furious SILENT disapproval: enormous unequal white eyes narrowed differently, straight pinched upper lip and jutting lower jaw, one single lower tooth, stare toward viewer. Holds one fat rolled cream orders scroll vertically against her own side, other goo hand presses it firmly shut. No spyglass, saber or raised pointing gesture. Two brass buttons, not a full coat.
TOP MIDDLE — MALE-READ BUGLER SERGEANT. Short broad hourglass-shaped soft splat with a huge droopy lower lobe, sideways slouchy navy forage cap with brass horn badge, blue cuff and modest chevron patch. Blissfully dreamy half-closed white eyes looking upward, cheeks puffed around mouthpiece, brows gently curved rather than angry V. Plays ONE squat curved brass BUGLE at his mouth, bell aimed diagonally down within cell, both hands visibly supporting it. Thick continuous curved tube with clear mouthpiece and bell, no random pipes. No other weapon.
TOP RIGHT — MALE-READ ENGINEER CORPORAL. Broad upright near-square blob with asymmetric low crown lobes, navy kepi, plain leather cross-strap and rolled sleeve cuff. Deep gloomy wounded pride: drooping white eyes, raised inner brow corners, massively protruding CLOSED lower lip and two uneven upper teeth poking down. Holds ONE short thick steel SPADE with wooden shaft upright close beside body; free hand draped over the shaft. Rounded spade point stays inside cell. No musket, drum or cannonball.
BOTTOM LEFT — FEMALE-READ SIGNAL LIEUTENANT. Round teardrop with high side quiff and subtle lashes, navy campaign hat tilted forward, a small simple brass collar bar, mustard cuff. Sudden joyful inspiration, one huge wide white eye and other tightly squinting, a shallow crooked grin of three unequal teeth. Holds ONE very short wooden signal-flag handle with a compact folded red-and-cream cloth flag attached, tucked across lower body. Free goo hand raised only to her own cheek in delighted realisation. No floating punctuation or running pose; all upright, no overlap.
BOTTOM MIDDLE — MALE-READ INFANTRY RECRUIT. Very round thick low bean body with THREE uneven fat drops at crown, oversized stiff navy kepi, one brass button, small leather cartridge pouch. Ridiculously proud closed-mouth self-satisfaction: large white eyes lifted sideways, one brow riding much higher than the other, off-center smug upper-lip curl and ONE big lower tooth. Hugs ONE shortened wooden-stock percussion RIFLE with thick steel barrel upright at own side, both hand grips visible, weapon full length contained in cell. Not frightened, no artillery props, no star rank.
BOTTOM RIGHT — MALE-READ FIELD-COOK CORPORAL. Tall top-heavy crooked splat, long sagging crown lobe, battered navy forage cap with flour smudge, short cream apron panel tied across own lower goo body. Explosive offended outrage: asymmetric bulging white eyes looking DOWN into his own prop, wrinkled brow and jagged sideways open mouth with uneven teeth, no tongue. Holds ONE large battered blue enamel COFFEE POT, hinged lid flipped open, black handle clearly gripped, exaggerated bent spout; other hand rests one stout wooden stirring spoon inside pot. No stove, smoke, flames, food scatter or scene.

COMPOSITION: a clean visually regular 3x2 grid, no lines. Same substantial BODY HEIGHT across both rows; full silhouettes approx450-475px tall in each512pxlogical cell, with clear transparent outer margins and gutters. Shape and prop position designed to fit each cell from the outset; keep bodies large and do not make bottom row miniature. All hats, spade, rifle, flag, bugle, pot, droplets COMPLETE and within own cell. No touching/overlap/props in neighboring cell. Background is alpha-zero TRANSPARENT, no floor, backdrop gradient, cast-shadow disk, checkerboard or halos. Character interiors fully opaque. Preserve handmade material fidelity while prioritizing six radically different expressive silhouettes and practical bold readable props.
